blocks.html: Keep Your Cannabis Fresh Longer with Proper Storage
Whether you've picked up your favorite flower, stocked up on edibles during a Star Buds sale, or purchased premium concentrates, proper storage can make all the
difference. Cannabis products are sensitive to light, heat, air, and moisture, and storing them correctly helps preserve their flavor, aroma, potency, and overall quality.
At Star Buds, we want every purchase to be just as enjoyable weeks later as it is the day you bring it home.
Why Storage Matters

Cannabis contains cannabinoids and terpenes that naturally degrade over time when exposed to poor storage conditions. While cannabis doesn't necessarily "go bad" overnight, improper storage can lead to:
Fortunately, a few simple habits can dramatically extend freshness.
Best Way to Store Cannabis Flower
Flower stays freshest when stored in an airtight glass container away from direct sunlight.
Avoid:
Instead, keep your cannabis in a cool, dark cabinet where temperatures remain consistent.
Storing Edibles
Edibles should always remain in their original child-resistant packaging whenever possible.
Depending on the product:

items: Gummies should stay sealed in a cool place.
Chocolates should be kept away from heat.
Beverages should follow the manufacturer's storage instructions.

blocks.html: Always check expiration dates before consuming.
Caring for Vape Cartridges and Concentrates
Store cartridges upright to reduce leaks and keep concentrates tightly sealed between uses.
Extreme heat can damage concentrates and affect flavor, so avoid leaving them in your car or direct sunlight.
Buy Fresh from Licensed Dispensaries
Purchasing from a licensed dispensary like Star Buds means you're getting products that have been properly stored from cultivation through retail, helping ensure consistent quality every time.
Whether you're shopping for premium flower, flavorful gummies, or the newest concentrates, our knowledgeable team can help you choose products that fit your lifestyle.
